convert_sam3_checkpoint: convert a SAM3 checkpoint from original Meta format to HuggingFace format and save locally
convert_sam3_checkpoint_push_to_hub: convert a SAM3 checkpoint to HuggingFace format and push the model and processor to the Hugging Face Hub
split_qkv_projections: split combined QKV weight tensors into separate q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj tensors in a state dict
convert_old_keys_to_new_keys: convert original SAM3 checkpoint keys to HuggingFace naming convention using regex-based key mapping
run_conversion_cli: run the SAM3-to-HF conversion script from the command line with checkpoint path and output path arguments
